# Acting capacity and membership

Identity, capacity, membership, and authorization are four different things.
Holding one never implies another.

## Membership rules

- Membership places an acting capacity inside a workspace for a stated purpose.
- Membership never authorizes a record. Each record is authorized separately.
- A record visible to one member is not therefore visible to every member.
- Membership expires. An expired membership authorizes nothing.

## Capacities on record

### Founder and developer operator (active)

- Policy basis: Governed boundary statement: founder and developer operator only.
- May decide: Approve, decline, or defer any governance artifact within the governed boundary.; Record architecture decisions and implementation work.; Declare a claim refused.
- Requires other authority: Independent accessibility, security, or privacy validation.; Any external conformance or efficacy claim.; Any processing of real learner, educator, or district data.
- Expiry trigger: A second authorized human joins, at which point duties must be separated.

### Academic authority (preview) (simulated-preview)

- Policy basis: Independence rule: builder may not validate educational claims.
- May decide: Would approve educational validity claims.
- Requires other authority: Release authority; Security and privacy sign-off
- Expiry trigger: Not staffed. Becomes real only when the role is filled.

## Memberships

- **command-center** / founder-developer — Accountable operator for the whole governed shell.. Purpose: See what requires responsible attention across SSLS.. Scope: decision, finding, evidence, risk, work-item.
- **strategy-governance** / founder-developer — Holder of governance authority while SSLS is one person.. Purpose: Record and maintain direction, authority, and constraint.. Scope: decision, policy-rule, standard, approval.
- **engineering-delivery** / founder-developer — Sole implementer of the governed shell.. Purpose: Build and record implementation work against approved decisions.. Scope: work-item, deliverable-instance, evidence.
- **trust-quality-assurance** / founder-developer — Self-assessment only. The operator reviews their own work, which is recorded as a known independence gap.. Purpose: Record findings, risks, and evidence honestly, including the gap itself.. Scope: finding, risk, evidence, validation.
- **research-intelligence** / founder-developer — Sole researcher working from public sources.. Purpose: Record sources, findings, and unknowns distinctly.. Scope: source, finding, evidence, knowledge-object.
